note: Proposed colour tokens of the nyx window (ADR 90, provisional). Every pair below is checked by docs/ux/contrast.py. Source of today's values: crates/app/src/theme.rs.

raised.use: hover and pressed neutral fills, popups

separator.use: dividers and card outlines only; never a control edge

control_edge.use: edge of buttons, fields, combo boxes, checkboxes (>= 3:1)

muted.use: secondary text (>= 7:1 on page and card in light, 6.2:1 on raised in dark)

accent.use: primary action fill, links, focus ring, selected bar

tint.use: selected item background (with a 2 px accent bar)

activity.use: running, queued, stale: fill, text on it is on_activity

activity_text.use: activity colour used as text; light needs the dark amber on activity_tint

activity_tint.use: background of the busy chip and stale band

success.use: saved, converged, passed (always with a glyph and a word)

danger.use: failed, destructive (always with a glyph and a word)

canvas.use: viewport and plot background; follows the theme unless Settings says always dark

data.validated_by: dataviz validate_palette.py: dark vs #181A1E all PASS (worst adjacent CVD dE 8.4); light vs #F4F2F4 PASS with contrast WARN on 4 slots (relief: domain numbers drawn on the mesh)
data.beyond_8: hatch plus number; never a generated ninth hue

rules: One filled accent object per view (Compute). Selection is tint plus a 2 px accent bar.
Amber means time or attention (running, queued, stale) and nothing else.
Every state has a glyph and a word next to its colour.
No Color32 literal outside theme.rs and colormap.rs (test in the app crate).
Neutrals keep OKLCH chroma <= 0.026; the plum cast lives in text, accent and tint.
